name: 15222 · Pittsburgh, PA
findings: ZIP 15222 (Pittsburgh) has 419 nonprofit organizations. 180 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 163 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15222 (Pittsburgh) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15222 (Pittsburgh) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 18.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 163 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
